name: nothing changed
description: all three documents are equal: the result is the document, no conflicts

name: only ours edits a block
description: a change on one side is taken as it is

name: only theirs edits a block
description: a change on the other side is taken as it is

name: disjoint edits merge
description: two sides edit different elements of the same lesson: both edits are in the result

name: the same edit on both sides
description: both sides made the identical change: not a conflict

name: same element edited differently
description: one conflict per element: the result keeps ours and names the conflict

name: different fields of one element
description: no field-level merge in v1: editing different fields of one element on both sides is still one conflict

name: ours deletes an untouched element
description: a removal the other side did not touch goes through

name: theirs deletes an untouched element
description: a removal the other side did not touch goes through

name: both delete the same element
description: no conflict

name: ours deletes what theirs edited
description: delete against edit is a conflict; the result keeps ours, so the element stays out

name: ours edits what theirs deleted
description: edit against delete is a conflict; the result keeps ours, so the element stays

name: ours deletes a lesson theirs edited a block of
description: removing an element conflicts with a change anywhere below it; the whole lesson is held out

name: theirs deletes a lesson ours edited a block of
description: the lesson and everything in it stay as ours, as one conflict at the lesson

name: a removal with an addition below it
description: adding an element under something the other side removed is a change below it

name: both add elements at different places
description: additions from both sides are kept, each next to its neighbour

name: both add at the same place
description: elements added after the same neighbour: the server's order stands and ours follows its neighbour

name: ours reorders, theirs edits
description: a reorder on one side and an edit on the other both apply

name: only theirs reorders
description: the reordering side wins the order

name: both reorder differently
description: the server's order is kept and a note says so

name: ours moves a lesson to another module
description: a move on one side is taken

name: theirs moves a block to another lesson
description: a move on one side is taken, including into a lesson the other side edited

name: both move to different places
description: a conflict; the result keeps ours

name: ours renames, theirs moves
description: own data from one side and the place from the other

name: the same new id with different content
description: impossible for minted ids, but a conflict if it happens

name: the same new element on both sides
description: identical additions are one element

name: both replace the interaction
description: a single slot holds one element: the other becomes a conflict

name: defaults are not changes
description: an empty citation list and the default content type are the same as absent

name: line ends are not changes
description: Markdown is compared with LF line ends and no trailing blank lines

name: a question and its options
description: options are elements too: edits to different options merge

name: course settings
description: root fields are one element

name: pages edited on both sides
description: the landing and header pages are one element

name: empty page slots and a null final test
description: the slots the folder leaves out are kept as they were and never compared

name: a final test appears on one side
description: a single slot that was null is filled by one side

name: a new module with a lesson on one side
description: an added subtree arrives whole
